board-side-castle.pieces: Ke1 Ra1 Rh1 Pa2 Pb2 Pc2 Pf2 Pg2 Ph2 Nf3 Bc4 ke8 qd8 rh8 bc5 nc6 pa7 pb7 pf7 pg7 ph7

steps.label: Your King and one of your Rooks switch places.
Then the turn passes to Black.

running-king.pieces: Kd3 Pc2 Pe3 Pg2 ke8 rh8 pf7 pg7

steps.label: Your King moves two squares instead of one.

teleport.pieces: Kg1 Rf1 Pf2 Pg2 Ph2 Pa2 Pb2 Nc3 kg8 rd8 qh4 bc5 pe5 pf7 pg7 ph7

steps.label: Your King and another piece switch places.
Then the turn passes to Black.

rush.pieces: Kg1 Pc2 Pd3 Pe4 kg8 pc7 pd6 pf7

steps.label: A Pawn moves two squares instead of one, even off its starting square.

stealth.pieces: Kg1 Nb1 Pa2 Pf2 Pg2 Ph2 kg8 rd8 pe6 pf7 pg7 ph7

steps.label: Move one of your pieces to any empty square, as long as it doesn't give check.
Then the turn passes to Black.

isolate.pieces: Kg1 Qd1 Pd4 Pe4 kg8 qd8 nf6 pe6 pf7 pg7

steps.label: Choose one of Black's pieces: it can't move on Black's next turn.
Then make your move as normal.

aura.pieces: Kg1 Rd1 Pf2 Pg2 kg8 ra5 pf7 pg7

steps.label: Choose an empty square. No piece may move to or over it.
Until your next turn, Black's Rook can't cross it.

reroute.pieces: Kg1 Pc2 Pd4 Pf2 kg8 pc6 pd5 pf7

steps.label: One of your Pawns changes file: it steps sideways.

formation.pieces: Kg1 Pc2 Pd2 Pe2 Pg2 Ph2 kg8 pc7 pd7 pe7 pg7

steps.label: Move one Pawn, and every Pawn in its island can make the same move.

hello-neighbor.pieces: Kg1 Pd3 Pe4 kg8 pe5 pf7

steps.label: Your Pawns can move diagonally without capturing.

retreat.pieces: Kg1 Pd4 Pe5 kg8 pd6 pf7 nb8

steps.label: Your Pawns can move backwards this turn.

fortress.pieces: Kg1 Ne5 Pd4 Pf2 kg8 qe7 rd8 pd6 pf7

steps.label: Choose a piece: Black can't capture it on their next turn.
The Pawn and Queen that attack it have to look elsewhere.

symmetry.pieces: Kg1 Bc4 Nf3 Pe4 kg8 bc5 nf6 pe5

steps.label: Pick two identical pieces of different colours.
Both are removed from the board.

safety-measures.pieces: Kg1 Rd1 Pf2 Pg2 Ph2 kg8 rb8 qd6 pf7 pg7

steps.label: On Black's next turn, they can't put your King in check.
So the Rook can't give check on your back rank.

compelled.pieces: Kg1 Ne4 Pd3 Pf2 kg8 qd8 nf6 pd5 pf7

steps.label: On Black's next turn, they must capture a piece.
Black has to take, even when it's a trap.
And you take back.

risk.pieces: Ke1 Nb1 Pd2 Pf2 kh8 re8 pg7 ph7

steps.label: Your King is in check, and you ignore it.
Make any other move instead.
On Black's next turn your King can't be captured, and you can't give check either.
Your Pawns can capture in any direction, even backwards.
Your Pawns can capture straight ahead.
Your Pawns can capture sideways.

bodyguard.pieces: Kg1 Ra1 Pg2 Ph2 kg8 qf6 pf7 pg7

steps.label: Put a captured Pawn on an empty square next to your King.
Then the turn passes to Black.

promotion.pieces: Kg1 Ra1 Pd5 Pe4 Pg2 kg8 rd8 pf7 pg7

steps.label: With no Queen of your own on the board, one of your Pawns becomes a Queen.
Then the turn passes to Black.

displaced.pieces: Kg1 Ra1 Bc1 Pf2 Pg2 Ph2 kg8 re8 pf7 pg7

steps.label: Lift one piece off the board.
Your Rook slides through the gap.
At the end of your turn the piece returns to its square.

kingified.pieces: Kg1 Pd4 Pe4 kg8 bd6 pe5

steps.label: Your Pawns can move like a King: any direction, one square.

pawnified.pieces: Kg1 Bc4 Nf3 kg8 pd6 pf7

steps.label: Your pieces can move like a Pawn: here a Bishop steps straight ahead.
Your Pawns can move like a Knight.
Your Pawns can move like a Bishop: all the way down the diagonal.
Your Pawns can move like a Rook: straight across the board.
Your Pawns can move like a Queen.

exchange.pieces: Kg1 Rd1 Pf2 Pg2 kg8 pf7 pg7

steps.label: Take one of your pieces off the board: a Rook, worth 5.
Put a captured piece of equal or lower value on that square: a Knight, worth 3.
You gain the difference: 2 points.

backup.pieces: Kg1 Pa2 Pf2 Pg2 kg8 pe5 pf7

steps.label: Put a captured Pawn on an empty square of your second rank.
Your Knight captures the Queen…
…and becomes a Queen itself.

balance.pieces: Kg1 Pf2 Pg2 kg8 pf7 pg7

steps.label: Black may put a captured Pawn on their second rank.
Then you may do the same.

plan-b.pieces: Kg1 Nf3 Pf2 Pg2 Ph2 kg8 qh4 pe5 pf7 pg7

steps.label: Black's last move is taken back.
Black has to play a different legal move.

take-priority.intro: You hold Take Priority in your opening hand and play Black.
take-priority.pieces: Ra1 Nb1 Bc1 Qd1 Ke1 Bf1 Ng1 Rh1 Pa2 Pb2 Pc2 Pd2 Pe2 Pf2 Pg2 Ph2 ra8 nb8 bc8 qd8 ke8 bf8 ng8 rh8 pa7 pb7 pc7 pd7 pe7 pf7 pg7 ph7

steps.label: Black makes the first move of the game.
Then White replies.

armageddon.pieces: Kd4 ke8 qa1 rh2 bb7 nc6 pa7 pb6 pf7 pg6

steps.label: Your King is your only piece left on the board.
Play Armageddon and you win the game.

suspend.pieces: Kg1 Nb1 Pd2 Pe2 Pf2 kg8 pd7 pe7 pf7

steps.label: Skip this turn: you make no move.
Black plays.
You take your next turn…
…and an extra turn right after it.

frames.label: Your opponent's hidden hand is revealed to you.
Revisit goes onto the discard pile.
Take any card from the discard pile back into your hand.
You answer with Deny for 1 point.
In return, you can't play a card on your next turn.
